name: Motus
summary: Motus runs mileage reimbursement programs for companies with many drivers. Its driver app captures GPS-verified mileage, and its CPM and FAVR programs set the rate per mile or per vehicle. Motus publishes no prices, and every product is sold by quote.

facts.text: The Motus pricing page describes GPS-verified mileage capture in the driver app.
On Motus's page, the CPM program pays employees a per-mile rate, typically the IRS standard mileage rate, set by the employer.
Per the page, the FAVR program uses IRS-substantiated logic for fixed and variable vehicle costs.
Built-in reporting and visibility across the driver population, and end-to-end reimbursement processing, are listed on the vendor's page.
Motus's page says all pricing is by quote, priced per driver with volume discounts, and that contracts are typically annual.

plans.name: Motus Reimburse
plans.notes: No prices published. Programs are FAVR, CPM and TAAP, and they can be used alone or together.

hiddenCosts: The page publishes no prices for Motus Protect or the add-ons, which include Insights Pro analytics and HRIS, payroll and SAP Concur connections.
